note: Modelling assumptions, NOT facts and NOT policy. Every value is a placeholder the user should override in the scenario's assumptions block. Rates are annual decimals; money is SGD.
source_note: Agent defaults for scenario analysis; replace with bank quotes, MCST/HDB bills and your own estimates.

interest_rate.applies_to: bank loans (floating); HDB loan uses the fixed rate in policy-tables.json

appreciation.applies_to: annual change in market value of the property

opportunity_cost.note: Forgone return on the down payment: cash in a savings/T-bill alternative; CPF at the OA rate.
